name: Small nonzero signed harmonic subsums
description: Return exactly 30 integer coefficients from {-1,0,1}. The signed sum coefficient[i-1]/i must be nonzero. Minimize its absolute value; exact numerator and denominator are reported. Finite signed-harmonic extremum with the zero sum excluded; no asymptotic separation claim.
